# Zmanim Today

> A free, location-aware Progressive Web App for daily Jewish prayer times (zmanim), a live compass to Jerusalem, and three complete digital siddurim. Built for one person's own daily use and shared publicly.

Zmanim Today shows halachic zmanim (alot hashachar, sof zman shma, mincha, candle lighting, tzeit, and more) computed by the [Hebcal](https://www.hebcal.com/) zmanim API for the user's detected or searched location — no account or manual setup required. It also includes a device-orientation compass that points toward Jerusalem, full Ashkenazi, Sephardic, and Chabad siddur texts with table-of-contents navigation, and opt-in browser push reminders sent ahead of each zman. It installs as an offline-capable PWA.

It is intended for individuals who want quick, accurate daily prayer times and siddur text for their own use — not a synagogue, organizational, or scholarly reference product. It is independently built and maintained by a single developer; it is not affiliated with Hebcal, Sefaria, or any Jewish organization.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zmanimtoday.base44.app/): Landing page — next upcoming zman, mini compass, and daily summary for the user's current location.
- [Zmanim](https://zmanimtoday.base44.app/Zmanim): Full daily halachic zmanim for the detected or searched location, with push reminder controls.
- [Compass](https://zmanimtoday.base44.app/Compass): Live, device-orientation-based compass pointing toward Jerusalem.
- [Ashkenazi Siddur](https://zmanimtoday.base44.app/AshkenaziSiddur): Full Ashkenazi prayer text with table-of-contents and segment navigation.
- [Sephardic Siddur](https://zmanimtoday.base44.app/SephardicSiddur): Full Sephardic prayer text with table-of-contents and segment navigation.
- [Chabad Siddur](https://zmanimtoday.base44.app/ChabadSiddur): Full Chabad (Nusach Ari) prayer text with table-of-contents and segment navigation.
- [Settings](https://zmanimtoday.base44.app/Settings): Location, notification, and display preferences.

## Notes

- Zmanim calculations are sourced live from the Hebcal API, not computed independently by this app.
- This is a personal project with no organizational backing, editorial board, or halachic authority — treat zmanim and siddur text as convenience references, not a substitute for a qualified posek.
